remainingRisks: All real PostgreSQL SQL/constraint/trigger/transaction/locking/timeout/atomicity/commit-ambiguity/rollback assertions remain unexecuted. Unit passes do not establish transaction correctness.
Saved schema evidence may be stale and full Auth/application schema, database major-version differences, RLS and privileges are not reproduced by the reduced fixture.

SQL cannot identify a Neon branch. A separately trusted current control-plane attestation must bind project, branch, endpoint, database and operator authority; no such actual evidence or trusted real-world signer mapping is supplied here.
Table-wide Auth/member/audit locks briefly block other writers; eventual operator approval must accept contention and abort-on-timeout behavior.
Read-only reconciliation cannot prove absence from stale reads or guarantee safe replay after ambiguous commit. No automatic retry is authorized.
Rollback requires independently verified complete activity coverage and maintained quiescence. The schema alone cannot prove absence of legitimate intervening activity.
Database administrators can bypass audit protections; retain external immutable approval and execution evidence. Checksums must be independently approved, not merely read from a mutable manifest.
